name: security_definer_view

metadata.statement: CREATE VIEW public.view_crm_profiles WITH (security_barrier=false) AS SELECT ...

details: View operates under definition privileges bypassing RLS row context of callers.
remediation: ALTER VIEW public.view_crm_profiles SET (security_barrier=true); or convert to SECURITY INVOKER.

name: function_search_path_mutable

metadata.identity_arguments: p_name text, p_target_tag text, p_sequence jsonb, p_contacts jsonb, p_min_delay_sec integer, p_max_delay_sec integer, p_created_by uuid

details: SECURITY DEFINER function does not force search_path = public.
remediation: ALTER FUNCTION public.rpc_create_campaign(...) SET search_path = public;

name: function_search_path_mutable
details: SECURITY DEFINER function does not force search_path = public.
remediation: ALTER FUNCTION public.search_contacts(text) SET search_path = public;

name: rls_disabled_in_public
details: Table wa_auth_state exists in schema public with row level security disabled.
remediation: ALTER TABLE public.wa_auth_state ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

name: public_bucket_listable
details: Storage bucket spa-media is public and allows list operations.
remediation: Set public = false on bucket spa-media or configure row level policies.
